top_stories.title: Quant Smallcap among 16 equity mutual funds that multiply lumpsum investments by over 2.3x in 5 years - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Motilal Oswal Midcap Fund** was the top performer, with a 2.58 times return on a Rs 1 lakh investment over five years.  Other funds that saw significant growth include **Nippon India Mutual Fund's** Nippon India Growth Mid Cap Fund and Nippon India Small Cap Fund, which both multiplied investments by 2.50 times.  Several other mutual funds also achieved strong returns, including HDFC Mid Cap Fund, Invesco India Smallcap Fund, and HSBC Midcap Fund, with some exceeding a 2.3 times return.

top_stories.title: New 4-winged dinosaur discovered in China sheds light on the origins of flight | Technology News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A new fossil discovery in China has revealed a feathered dinosaur with four wing-like structures on its hind limbs, challenging the traditional understanding of flight evolution. **Researchers** believe these extra wings may have aided in gliding and maneuvering through forests, providing aerodynamic control for the animal. This finding adds to the growing body of evidence suggesting that early dinosaurs experimented with various forms of movement before bird flight evolved.  The discovery was made by a team led by Ling-Qi Zhou and published in the Annals of Carnegie Museum.

top_stories.title: Hooch deaths: ‘Perfect case of government negligence; what was learned from 2015 Malwani liquor tragedy?’ asks Congress | Pune News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: Following the deaths of over 20 people in Pune due to spurious liquor, **the Maharashtra government** has penalized 26 officials and employees. However, the **Congress party**, led by Sachin Sawant, criticized this action as insufficient and demanded accountability for past recommendations made after a similar tragedy in Malwani in 2015. The committee's recommendations included stricter control over methanol production and transportation, increased police and excise department campaigns against illegal liquor manufacturing, information sharing between departments, and strict enforcement of regulations. Sawant questioned the government's commitment to implementing these recommendations and demanded transparency regarding their status. He also highlighted the lack of preparedness in hospitals and the ease with which accused individuals were granted bail, emphasizing the need for stricter action against organized crime involved in illegal liquor trade.

top_stories.title: India’s Mundra Port linked to Saudi Arabia’s Jeddah in new Red Sea shipping route - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)** has launched a new shipping service connecting Jeddah Islamic Port with India's Mundra Port and the Port of Djibouti. The "SRS" service, capable of carrying up to 2,144 TEUs, aims to improve supply chain efficiency and facilitate trade flows across the Red Sea. This initiative supports Saudi Arabia's National Transport and Logistics Strategy, which seeks to position the country as a global logistics hub.

top_stories.title: BMC panel nod to appoint consultants for Rs 3 cr without tenders for 2 civic projects | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation** (BMC) standing committee approved two proposals allowing the administration to appoint external agencies without tenders, at a cost of Rs 3 crore. The approvals allow for the appointment of **IIT-B** as a proof-checking agency for a proposed transit hub in Dahisar and **Ernst & Young (E&Y)** as a technical and management consultant for the BMC’s Participate Mumbai initiative.  The administration requested exemption from the standard tendering process, citing the need to address social and cultural development, educational initiatives, welfare measures, environmental sustainability, and awareness. The decisions come after scrutiny over the BMC's use of Project Management Consultants (PMCs) instead of utilizing its own departments for civic projects.

top_stories.title: After Annamalai’s exit, Tamil Nadu BJP Vice President, senior leaders walk out of party | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **K Annamalai**, former **BJP** president of **Tamil Nadu**, has resigned from the party, sparking a split in its state unit.  **Karu Nagarajan**, vice-president, and **Abhilash Gopinath**, BJP Yuva Morcha legal convener, have also resigned in support of Annamalai's new political movement. The former IPS officer aims to establish "common man politics," rejecting personality-driven politics and hereditary power.  Over 8.09 lakh people enrolled as volunteers on his newly launched platform, https://wetheleader.org/.

top_stories.title: Henry Nowak case: How handcuffed UK student's murder by Sikh man sparked national outrage - timeline of events - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: The murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak by Sikh man Vickrum Singh Digwa sparked national outrage after police bodycam footage showed him being handcuffed while suffering from stab wounds. **Digwa** was convicted of murder and possession of a bladed article, with his mother, **Kiran Kaur**, also found guilty of assisting an offender.  The case drew reactions from prominent figures including **Prime Minister Keir Starmer** and billionaire Elon Musk, who commented on the incident on social media. Protests across the UK demanding accountability for the police response to the attack erupted after the release of bodycam footage.

top_stories.title: Quant Smallcap among 16 equity mutual funds that multiply lumpsum investments by over 2.3x in 5 years - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Motilal Oswal Midcap Fund** was the top performer, with a 2.58 times return on a Rs 1 lakh investment over five years. **Nippon India Mutual Fund**, **HDFC Mutual Fund**, and other funds also saw significant growth, with returns ranging from 2.17% to 2.58%. The analysis was conducted to identify mutual funds that multiplied investments by 2.3 times in the last five years, but it is not a recommendation for investment decisions.

top_stories.title: Unocoin Bitcoin theft case: Karnataka Police SIT names Congress MLA N A Haris’s son in chargesheet | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mohammed Nalapad**, a youth Congress leader, and his brother **Omar Nalapad**, along with hacker **Sriki** and his accountant **Robin Khandelwal**, are named in a chargesheet filed by the **Karnataka Police** for the theft of Bitcoin worth Rs 1.14 crore from the Unocoin crypto exchange in 2017. The investigation, which began in 2023, is linked to multiple cases involving stolen cryptocurrency and money laundering.  The ED has also arrested Sriki, Khandelwal, and associate **Sunish Hegde** for allegedly laundering funds obtained through hacking various online systems between 2017 and 2020. The investigation is ongoing.

top_stories.title: Oyo parent Prism Hotels receives Sebi nod for IPO - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Prism**, the rebranded parent entity of a travel and hospitality company, has received approval from **Sebi** to proceed with an initial public offering (IPO). The IPO is expected to raise $7–8 billion in fresh equity shares, aiming to strengthen its balance sheet, expand into new markets, and achieve profitability.  The listing is seen as a sign of renewed investor interest in technology-driven consumer internet companies in India after a period of subdued IPO activity.
